findings.description: Umbelina Maria Azevedo died on 14 November 1910 in the city of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, where her death was registered in the civil register; the entry indexes her as Umbelina Azevedo Da Silva, born about 1879.

details.place: Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

supporting_sources: Brasil, Rio de Janeiro, Registro Civil, 1804-2013 — death entry for Umbelina Azevedo Da Silva, 14 Nov 1910
